findings.summary: The assertions at 260 and 262 compare the returned row and the recorded call against "all_debug", which is both the literal the test passed in and MAINTENANCE_PARTITION at reckon/crew/repository_maintenance.py:44, so they stay green if submit_pass stopped honouring its partition argument and fell back to the default; a non-default partition would make the assertion independent. Non-blocking because a fully dropped argument would leave calls[0]["partition"] None, so the regression the test exists for is still caught.

The comment above assert active.ticked == 1 and the commit message both state the tick reached the sweep, but the _Station stand-in's tick at line 83 only increments a counter and never runs the real Station.tick, so the assertion proves run_station ticked once, not that the tick consults the maintenance sweep; that half is covered by the hand-built station at line 182.

VERDICT goal: the increment is the three commits 150a6b8349, d168088025 and 7297a989c9 over tests/test_the_schedule_needs_no_hand_command.py, reckon/crew/repository_maintenance.py, reckon/crew/fleet_node.py and tests/test_a_scheduled_maintenance_pass_keeps_a_repository_packed.py; repository_maintenance.py:400 now submits through fleet_node.submit and repository_maintenance.py:125 publishes the record through write_atomically.
VERDICT done_when: the section's done_when measures the partition of the submitted job and the loose-count/cruft/record/gc.log clauses; the increment leaves the gate green at head (gate-after-final.log, 8 passed, EXIT=0) and the base arm red at base (base-arm.log, 6 failed, EXIT=1), and tests/test_the_schedule_needs_no_hand_command.py:170 asserts the submitted argv carries --partition=all_debug.
VERDICT write_paths: the source node's declared paths were reckon, tests, docs/evidence/fragments/work-flows-to-the-lane and its figure directory; every path in this increment lies inside them.
VERDICT manifest: read; it records status complete, nine commits, both suite arms with revision, command and exit status, and three negative-control logs; the two repair controls named for this increment each end EXIT=1.
VERDICT diff: read commit by commit from 2fa5fed9e6563fb7b251e0bd77d1021961082d4d to 7297a989c9f5389e78adaf26b4a82d3c781e8d56; three commits, four files, all four named in the review scope, with fleet_node.submit gaining keyword-only partition and runner seams and maintaining every existing caller's argv unchanged.
CALL_SITES: reckon/crew/station.py:1262, reckon/crew/repository_maintenance.py:441, reckon/project_setup_commands.py:210, reckon/crew/fleet_node.py:1081
SCORE goal_fidelity: 19
JUSTIFICATION goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/repository_maintenance.py:400 hands the built script to fleet_node.submit with the partition on the argv, which is the one submission form every other partitioned launch uses.
SCORE evidence: 18
JUSTIFICATION evidence: gate-after-final.log runs the two node test files at 7297a989 with 8 passed and EXIT=0, base-arm.log runs them at 108d56a4 with 6 failed and EXIT=1, and both repair arms sit in repair-baseline-arm.log and repair-after-arm-final.log at 0 failures each, so added_failure_count is 0.
SCORE scope_discipline: 20
JUSTIFICATION scope_discipline: the diff touches exactly reckon/crew/fleet_node.py, reckon/crew/repository_maintenance.py and the two named test files, and nothing outside the declared paths.
SCORE durability: 17
JUSTIFICATION durability: repair-negative-control.log shows test_every_staged_write_reaches_the_owner failing without the shared-writer change and repair-negative-control-wiring.log shows tests/test_the_schedule_needs_no_hand_command.py:308 failing without the run_station construction, but tests/test_the_schedule_needs_no_hand_command.py:260 and :262 assert against "all_debug", the value the test passed and the module default at repository_maintenance.py:44, so neither can tell a propagated partition from the default.
SCORE fit: 19
JUSTIFICATION fit: reckon/crew/fleet_node.py:293 mirrors the runner seam query_jobs already offers at fleet_node.py:325, and repository_maintenance.py:125 uses the shared writer every other publication uses.
SCORE reuse: 19
JUSTIFICATION reuse: the schedule's own sbatch invocation named in the prior review is gone from reckon/crew/repository_maintenance.py and the call now extends reckon/crew/fleet_node.py:289, its owner, rather than duplicating it.
FINDING tests/test_the_schedule_needs_no_hand_command.py:260 non-blocking: the assertions at 260 and 262 compare the returned row and the recorded call against "all_debug", which is both the literal the test passed in and the module default at reckon/crew/repository_maintenance.py:44, so they stay green if submit_pass stopped honouring its partition argument and used the default; a non-default partition would make the assertion independent. Non-blocking because calls[0]["partition"] is None if the argument is dropped entirely, so the nested-launch regression the test exists for is still caught.
FINDING tests/test_the_schedule_needs_no_hand_command.py:312 non-blocking: the comment above the assertion and the commit message both say the tick reached the sweep, but _Station.tick at line 83 only increments a counter and never runs the real Station.tick, so active.ticked == 1 proves run_station ticked once and not that the tick consults the sweep; that half is covered by the hand-built station at line 182, so the coverage exists but the claim is wider than the assertion.
